key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Toggle CmdBar visibility in the top panel.

key.name: placeholder-text
key.description: Customize the input placeholder text for commands with parameters.

key.name: button-label
key.description: Customize the text displayed next to the icon in the top-bar button.

key.name: shortcut
key.description: Global keyboard shortcut to trigger CmdBar menu from anywhere.

key.name: sandbox-engine
key.description: Default sandbox engine used for isolated execution (bwrap, flatpak-spawn, or firejail).

key.name: enable-sandbox
key.description: Toggle default sandboxed execution for all commands.

key.name: auto-format-output
key.description: Automatically format command output into pretty JSON, CSV/TSV tables, or code blocks.

key.name: custom-app-name
key.description: White label application name overriding CmdBar branding.

key.name: custom-logo-path
key.summary: Custom Logo Path or Icon Name
key.description: File path or symbolic icon name for custom enterprise logo.

key.name: brand-primary-color
key.description: Primary hex color code for white label custom theme styling.

key.name: domain-alias
key.description: Custom domain alias endpoint for enterprise server communications.

key.name: audit-privacy-mode
key.description: Exclude sensitive commands containing passwords or marked secure from audit log.

key.name: lazy-load-categories
key.description: Only load command items when a category is expanded in the menu.

key.name: virtual-page-size
key.description: Number of command items to render per virtual list page/chunk.
